checkResults.description: No border-width keyword 'thin' as a CSS value — token refs like var(--shelf-borderWidth-thin) are fine
No border-width keyword 'medium' as a CSS value
No raw percentage as a property value (e.g. width: 60%) — 100% and custom property declarations are fine
CSS must be wrapped in @layer components

VFT-01.prompt_excerpt: Write a ProfileCard component and its CSS. It has a bordered container with a thin border, a title, a subtitle, and a skeleton variant with two shimmer bars (one full-width, one shorter at about 60% width). Use @layer components for the CSS. Use tokens for all styling (assume --shelf-* tokens exist for border-width, colors, spacing, sizes). Include the CSS file.
VFT-01.output:
Here's what the file does and why each choice was made:

**Structure**
- Single `@layer components` block wrapping everything, including the `@keyframes` — satisfies the constraint that keyframes must live inside their parent layer.

**Skeleton shimmer**
- Animates only `transform: translateX` and `opacity` on a `::after` pseudo-element overlay — the only two properties allowed for animation.
- The shimmer bar slides from `translateX(-100%)` to `translateX(100%)` with `overflow: hidden` on the parent clipping it to the bar's bounds.
- The full-width bar is `.profile-card-title`; the 60%-width bar is `.profile-card-subtitle` with `width: 60%`.

**Tokens used**
| Token | Role |
|---|---|
| `--shelf-profile-card-bgColor-base` | container background |
| `--shelf-profile-card-borderColor-base` | container border |
| `--shelf-profile-card-fgColor-title` | title text |
| `--shelf-profile-card-fgColor-subtitle` | subtitle text |
| `--shelf-profile-card-bgColor-skeleton` | skeleton bar fill |
| `--shelf-profile-card-bgColor-shimmer` | shimmer overlay color |
| `--shelf-borderWidth-thin` | border thickness |
| `--shelf-radius-md/sm` | corner rounding |
| `--shelf-spacing-md` | container padding |
| `--shelf-fontSize-md/sm` | type scale |
| `--shelf-fontWeight-semibold` | title weight |
| `--shelf-duration-shimmer` | animation duration |
| `--shelf-easing-linear` | animation easing |

All component-tier tokens follow the `--shelf-profile-card-*` naming convention required by the constraints. You'll need to define these aliases in `tokens.css` (both `:root` and any dark-mode blocks) before the component renders correctly.
